description: Look at a timeline (or a media file): up to 16 frames as one contact-sheet image (layout grid) or one image each (single). Media frames are numbered at the media frame rate; a picture that can be see-through (alpha or a palette) is shown over a light checkerboard, so transparency shows as checks and a background baked into the file as itself. size full: up to 4 frames at the sequence (or media) size from the original media, for thumbnails and stills to keep. format webp (default), png or jpeg, with quality for webp and jpeg. Each image comes inline and with a signed download url.

format.description: jpeg: for places that take nothing else; png: lossless

frames.description: Timeline frames, or media frames at the media rate

media_id.description: Media handle from media.import or a create.* tool

size.description: full: the sequence size from original media (long_edge ignored)

timeline_id.description: Timeline handle; every edit returns a new one

name: render.frames
title: Render frames
